sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the next word in a list ("Levites, ___ and heads of the Israelite families"). No earlier card has shown that list, and nothing in the setup lets the baker reason out "priests" over "prophets" or "scribes". Getting it right comes down to recalling the wording or luck.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
